source_message.text:
For authentication, use a hybrid approach so both crypto and non-crypto users can participate; the fiat on-ramp is important for accessibility:
- Wallet authentication with SIWE for crypto paths, especially mints and transfers.
- Email-based authentication for dashboard access to referrals, tickets and prizes, supporting fiat users who do not yet use a wallet.
- No authentication for public APIs such as leaderboards and pool values, keeping them open and transparent.

This matches the lean MVP: non-crypto users can mint through Stripe and email, while crypto users use a wallet. Keep email sign-in low-friction with magic links.

Brevo remains the email service. I will create the account and provide credentials soon. A paid Starter plan is acceptable if it materially improves UX or deliverability, but the value should justify the cost.

I will also create a Stripe test account and share the details shortly. For now, focus on fiat-to-USDC. We can discuss a low-cost paid add-on if it improves reliability or UX; the free tier is fine to begin with.
